title: Endpoint details
description: Structured output produced by the error-messages generator: process endpoints discovered from router files, together with the BFF endpoints that call them.

output.description: Map keyed by process name. Each entry contains the endpoints exported by that process's router.

[a-z-]+.description: List of endpoints exported by a specific backend process.

bff.description: List of BFF routes discovered in the backend-for-frontend package that map to backend process calls.

ErrorWithCode.description: A single error mapping from an endpoint mapper: the error code and the corresponding message text.

code.description: Error code identifier returned by the backend logic for this mapped failure.

message.description: Human-readable description associated with the error code.

ErrorMapper.description: Metadata for the error mapper linked to a router endpoint, including the mapped error codes used by that endpoint.

name.description: Name of the mapper referenced by the route definition.

file.description: Absolute or project-relative path to the file that contains the mapper implementation.

errors.description: List of error codes and messages extracted from the mapper file.

Service.description: Details of the backend service method bound to a route, resolved from the process router implementation.

name.description: Name of the service object or method referenced by the route.

method.description: Method name that handles the HTTP route within the service.

file.description: Path to the source file containing the service implementation.

startLine.description: Optional start line of the method definition in the source file.

endLine.description: Optional end line of the method definition in the source file.

BffProcess.description: A backend process that a BFF service calls, together with the method name used in that call.

process.description: Normalized process name, such as agreement, catalog, or tenant.

method.description: Method invoked on the process client from the BFF service.

BffService.description: Details of the BFF service method that exposes a route and the backend processes it depends on.

name.description: Name of the BFF service object or method referenced by the route.

file.description: Path to the BFF router source file.

startLine.description: Optional start line of the BFF handler method in the source file.

endLine.description: Optional end line of the BFF handler method in the source file.

processes.description: Backend processes invoked by this BFF service, mapped to the concrete client methods used.

OpenApi.description: OpenAPI metadata for the route, linking the router declaration to the generated API contract.

operationId.description: Unique OpenAPI operation identifier for the route.

path.description: HTTP path declared in the OpenAPI document.

fileName.description: Path to the OpenAPI YAML file used to resolve the route metadata.

BffEndpoint.description: A BFF endpoint entry discovered in the frontend-facing router and linked to the OpenAPI contract and backing service.

method.description: HTTP method of the BFF route, such as GET, POST, or PUT.

path.description: Route path exposed by the BFF endpoint.

fileName.description: Source router file where the BFF endpoint is declared.

openApi.description: OpenAPI operation metadata for this BFF route.

service.description: BFF service implementation associated with the route.

Endpoint.description: A backend process endpoint found in a router file, including its implementation, mapper, security roles and matching BFF routes.

method.description: HTTP method of the process route, such as GET, POST, PUT, or DELETE.

path.description: Route path declared in the process router.

fileName.description: Router file where the route is declared.

openApi.description: Matching OpenAPI operation metadata for this process endpoint.

service.description: Backend service method that handles the route.

mapper.description: Error mapper attached to the endpoint and the list of errors it resolves.

roles.description: Authorization roles required to invoke the endpoint.

bffEndpoints.description: Matching BFF endpoints that call this process endpoint.
